benefits.name: Purchase Security
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against theft or accidental damage for 90 days.
benefits.terms: Up to $500 per claim, $50,000 per cardholder per year. Standard Visa Signature benefit.

benefits.name: Warranty Manager Service (Extended Warranty)
benefits.description: Doubles the manufacturer's original U.S. warranty by up to one additional year on eligible warranties of 3 years or less.
benefits.terms: Capped at $10,000 per claim, $50,000 per cardholder. Standard Visa Signature benefit.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars in the U.S.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage only (not primary). Requires charging the entire rental to the card and declining the rental company's collision coverage. Standard Visa Signature benefit.

benefits.name: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.description: 24/7 referral service for medical/legal referrals, emergency transportation coordination, and translation assistance while traveling.
benefits.terms: Referral service only; cardholder is responsible for the cost of any services rendered. Standard Visa Signature benefit.

earningRates.terms: Base rate of 1.5% cash back on all purchases, no category restrictions or caps. Bank of America Preferred Rewards members earn a bonus on top of this base rate: Gold tier +25% (1.87% total), Platinum tier +50% (2.25% total), Platinum Honors / Preferred Rewards for Wealth Management tier +75% (2.62% total).
